message.content:
Build 7 shared components for the InkOS marketing site at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS/`. These will be used across 30+ marketing pages.

**Project context:**
- Next.js 16.2.3, React 19, TypeScript strict, Framer Motion 12, Tailwind v4
- Brand constants at `@/lib/brand` (BRAND, FONT, SHADOW, GRADIENT, fadeUp, stagger, ACCENT_MAP, AccentKey)
- Existing brand mark: `@/components/brand/tri-circle-mark` (TriCircleMarkV2)
- Existing blobs: `@/components/brand/mangomint-blobs` (MangomintBlobs)
- Existing photo: `@/components/brand/photo-band` (PhotoBand)
- Existing eyebrow/heading/subhead: `@/components/shared/section-{eyebrow,heading,subhead}`

**TypeScript rules:**
- Zero `any`. Strict mode. Use `React.CSSProperties` for inline styles.
- All exports named (no default). All props typed via interfaces.

**Brand voice reference:** Lift design from existing `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS/src/components/home/*.tsx` — these set the standard. Copy patterns.

---

## FILE 1: `src/components/shared/hero-section.tsx`

`"use client"`. Universal hero for marketing pages. Lifts homepage hero pattern but parameterised.

```typescript
interface HeroSectionProps {
  eyebrow: string;
  eyebrowAccent?: 'rust' | 'amber' | 'sage';
  // Headline supports an italic word in rust accent — split copy via italicWord
  headline: string;          // e.g. "The studio OS built like a {tattoo}, not a spreadsheet."
  italicWord?: string;       // word to render italic+rust (matches first occurrence)
  subhead: string;
  primaryCTA: { label: string; href: string };
  secondaryCTA?: { label: string; href: string; icon?: 'play' };  // PlayCircle icon if 'play'
  trustStats?: Array<{ stat: string; label: string }>;  // 4-col trust strip below CTAs
  variant?: 'default' | 'centered' | 'dark';  // default = left-aligned bone; centered = centered bone; dark = onyx with rust glow
  showBlobs?: boolean;  // default true
}
```

Behaviour:
- Eyebrow uses `<SectionEyebrow>`
- Headline = serif (FONT.serif), `clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px)`, weight 400. If `italicWord` provided, that exact substring renders as `<em>` italic + `BRAND.rust` color.
- Subhead = sans, 19px, stoneDark
- CTAs: primary = onyx pill bg+bone text + ArrowRight; secondary = bone bg + border + onyx text, optional PlayCircle icon
- TrustStats: grid 4-col with `v4-hero-trust` class for responsive
- Default variant: left-aligned, bone bg, MangomintBlobs hero variant + heroBloom gradient + grid texture
- Centered variant: text-align center, alignItems center
- Dark variant: BRAND.onyx bg, BRAND.bone text, MangomintBlobs cta variant + rust glow atmospheres
- All animations: motion fadeUp on intro, stagger on trust strip
- Section padding: 100px top, 80px bottom

---

## FILE 2: `src/components/shared/faq-accordion.tsx`

`"use client"`. Lift exact pattern from `src/components/home/close.tsx` FAQItem.

```typescript
interface FAQItem {
  q: string;
  a: string;
}

interface FAQAccordionProps {
  items: FAQItem[];
  defaultOpenIndex?: number;  // default 0
  accent?: 'rust' | 'amber' | 'sage';  // accent color for index numbers + open state
}
```

Behaviour:
- Card with `BRAND.white`, borderRadius 20, SHADOW.soft, max-width 920
- Each item: question row with mono index "01" "02" + question (17px bold) + Plus icon (rotates 45deg when open)
- Open item: rust circle bg around the X icon
- AnimatePresence for answer reveal
- Internal useState for active index (allows toggle off; null = all closed)

---

## FILE 3: `src/components/shared/cta-section.tsx`

`"use client"`. Lift exact pattern from homepage Close component (the dark bottom CTA section).

```typescript
interface CTASectionProps {
  badge?: string;  // small pill above heading, e.g. "The next sleeve starts in InkOS"
  headline: string;
  italicWord?: string;  // italic+rustBright in serif heading
  subhead: string;
  primaryCTA: { label: string; href: string };
  secondaryCTA?: { label: string; href: string; icon?: 'play' };
  showTriCircle?: boolean;  // default true — shows TriCircleMarkV2 size 56 above badge
}
```

Behaviour:
- BRAND.onyx background, MangomintBlobs cta variant + 2 rust glow atmospheres
- Centered content, max-width 720, padding 100 top/bottom
- TriCircleMarkV2 (56px) at top
- Badge: pill with rgba(247,247,245,0.08) bg, stoneLight text
- Headline: FONT.serif, clamp(42px, 6vw, 80px), italicWord in BRAND.rustBright italic
- Subhead: 17px stoneLight, max-width 520
- Primary CTA: bone bg + onyx text pill (boxShadow card)
- Secondary CTA: bordered transparent + stoneLight text, with optional PlayCircle icon
- All `<a>` tags. No buttons.

---

## FILE 4: `src/components/shared/comparison-table.tsx`

Server component (no client interactivity needed). Reusable competitor comparison table.

```typescript
type CellValue = boolean | string;  // true = green check, false = red dash, string = text annotation

interface ComparisonRow {
  feature: string;
  values: Record<string, CellValue>;  // keyed by competitor key, plus 'inkos'
}

interface Competitor {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  highlighted?: boolean;  // if true, show as featured column (rust accent)
}

interface ComparisonTableProps {
  competitors: Competitor[];  // first column is always "Feature", rest are competitors
  rows: ComparisonRow[];
  caption?: string;
}
```

Behaviour:
- White card, borderRadius 18, SHADOW.card
- 4px top accent strip (linear-gradient amber→rust→sage)
- Header row: bone-cream bg, uppercase 11px stone-light labels
- Rows alternate borderSoft dividers
- Cell rendering:
  - `true` → Check icon (sage, 14px)
  - `false` → minus icon ("—") in stoneLight
  - `string` → italic 12px stoneLight (e.g. "Pro tier only", "Extra fee")
- InkOS column is highlighted: rust-tinted background, every cell renders as Check (sage) when boolean true
- Caption row: 11px italic stoneFaint, centered below table

---

## FILE 5: `src/components/shared/testimonial-card.tsx`

Server component. Lift `ArtistStoryCardBright` from `src/components/home/proof.tsx`. Same structure but extracted into a reusable component.

```typescript
interface TestimonialStat {
  l: string;  // label
  v: string;  // value
}

interface TestimonialCardProps {
  name: string;
  role: string;
  city: string;
  chairs: string;
  quote: string;
  stats: TestimonialStat[];  // 3 stats
  gradient: string;  // CSS gradient string for portrait band
  initials: string;
  index?: number;  // for the "0X" badge
}
```

Behaviour: identical to proof.tsx ArtistStoryCardBright. White card, gradient portrait band (160px), serif initials overlay, MapPin city badge, name/role, italic quote with rust border-left, 3-stat table with mono values. whileHover y:-4 + SHADOW.glow.

---

## FILE 6: `src/components/shared/stat-strip.tsx`

Server component. Trust/social-proof strip for marketing pages.

```typescript
interface StatStripItem {
  stat: string;       // e.g. "1,200+", "$8.4M", "47"
  label: string;      // e.g. "artists on the waitlist"
}

interface StatStripProps {
  items: StatStripItem[];  // 3-5 items
  variant?: 'default' | 'dark';  // default = bone with border top; dark = transparent with rgba border (for dark sections)
  bordered?: boolean;  // default true — shows top + bottom borders
}
```

Behaviour:
- Grid columns based on items.length (use `grid-template-columns: repeat(N, 1fr)`)
- Each item: stat (18px, weight 600, onyx or bone) + label (13px stone or stoneLight)
- Apply `v4-hero-trust` className for responsive collapse on mobile
- Padding 28px vertical
- Border top + bottom if bordered=true

---

## FILE 7: `src/components/shared/page-breadcrumbs.tsx`

`"use client"` because it uses `usePathname`.

```typescript
interface PageBreadcrumbsProps {
  // Auto-generates from pathname. Override labels via map if needed.
  labelMap?: Record<string, string>;  // e.g. { 'for': 'For Studios', 'solo-artists': 'Solo Artists' }
}
```

Behaviour:
- Use `usePathname()` from `next/navigation`
- Split pathname into segments
- Render: Home / Segment 1 / Segment 2
- Each segment is a link except the last
- Use `<ChevronRight>` size 12 from lucide-react as separator
- Style: 12px sans, stone, stoneLight separators
- Auto-format slug to title case if no labelMap entry: "for" → "For", "solo-artists" → "Solo Artists"
- Container: flex with gap 6px, 14px top/bottom padding, max-width 1280, padding 0 32px

---

## FILE 8 (BONUS): `src/components/shared/logo-bar.tsx`

Server component. Logo strip for social proof.

```typescript
interface LogoBarProps {
  logos: Array<{ name: string; type?: 'studio' | 'press' }>;  // for v1, render as text labels (no actual logos yet)
  caption?: string;  // e.g. "Trusted by 200+ studios"
  variant?: 'default' | 'dark';
}
```

Behaviour:
- Caption above (centered, 11px uppercase stoneLight)
- Logo row: flex with 48px gap, opacity 0.6, hover opacity 1
- Each logo: text label in FONT.serif italic 22px stoneDark (until real logos drop in — placeholder)
- Center-align, padding 32px vertical

---

## Verification

After writing all 8 files:
1. `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS" && pnpm run type-check` — must pass clean
2. Confirm zero `any` types via `grep -r ": any" src/components/shared/`

Do NOT run builds or import these into pages yet — that's the next phase. Just write the components.

Reference styles: read `src/components/home/close.tsx`, `src/components/home/proof.tsx`, `src/components/home/hero.tsx`, and `src/components/home/migration.tsx` to match the exact visual language. Copy padding, shadows, colors, animations, hover states verbatim.
